agentConfig.title: Default running config
agentConfig.description: Configure runtime defaults for new Chats created with the current Agent
agentConfig.llmRetryEnabledTooltip: Automatically retry transient LLM API failures such as rate limits, timeouts, or connection errors. Applies to new requests after saving.
agentConfig.llmMaxRetriesTooltip: Maximum number of extra retry attempts for a retryable LLM request failure.
agentConfig.llmMaxRetriesMin: Max retries must be at least 1
agentConfig.llmBackoffBaseTooltip: Base delay before the first retry. Later retries use exponential backoff from this value.
agentConfig.llmBackoffBaseMin: Backoff base delay must be at least 0.1 seconds
agentConfig.llmBackoffCapTooltip: Maximum cap for exponential retry backoff delays.
agentConfig.llmBackoffCapMin: Backoff max delay must be at least 0.5 seconds
agentConfig.llmBackoffCapGteBase: Backoff max delay must be greater than or equal to the base delay
agentConfig.llmMaxConcurrentTooltip: Maximum number of LLM calls allowed in-flight at the same time. Shared across all agents; only the first initialization takes effect until restart.
agentConfig.llmMaxConcurrentRange: Max concurrent calls must be at least 1
agentConfig.llmMaxQpmTooltip: Maximum requests allowed within a 60-second sliding window. Requests exceeding this limit wait before being dispatched — proactively preventing 429 rate-limit errors. 0 = disabled.
agentConfig.llmMaxQpmRange: Max QPM must be at least 0
agentConfig.llmRateLimitPauseTooltip: Default pause duration (seconds) applied globally when a 429 rate-limit response is received. Overridden by the API's Retry-After header when present.
agentConfig.llmRateLimitPauseMin: Rate limit pause must be at least 1 second
agentConfig.llmRateLimitJitterTooltip: Random jitter range (seconds) added on top of the pause so concurrent waiters stagger their wake-up and avoid a new burst.
agentConfig.llmRateLimitJitterMin: Rate limit jitter must be at least 0 seconds
agentConfig.llmAcquireTimeoutTooltip: Maximum time (seconds) a caller will wait to acquire a rate-limiter slot before giving up with an error.
agentConfig.llmAcquireTimeoutMin: Slot acquire timeout must be at least 10 seconds
agentConfig.llmAcquireTimeoutGtPauseJitter: Slot acquire timeout must be greater than rate limit pause + jitter
agentConfig.memoryManagerBackendTooltip: Backend for the memory manager. Currently only ReMeLight is supported.
agentConfig.memoryManagerBackendRestartWarning: Switching the memory manager backend does not support hot reload. Save and restart Rua for changes to take effect.
agentConfig.maxItersTooltip: Maximum tool rounds per run. Set to 0 for unlimited rounds; you can still stop manually.
agentConfig.maxItersMin: Max iterations must be a nonnegative integer; 0 means unlimited
agentConfig.autoContinueOnTextOnlyTooltip: If the model ends a reasoning step with only text (no tool calls), inject a hint and run one extra reasoning pass with the same tool policy so multi-step tasks are less likely to stop silently. Turn off to match legacy behavior. May increase token usage when enabled.
agentConfig.showDebugMenuTooltip: Show Debug Capture controls in the more menu for Agent Chats and Project Chats.
agentConfig.maxInputLengthTooltip: Maximum input length (tokens) for the model context window
agentConfig.maxInputLengthMin: Max input length must be at least 1000
agentConfig.contextCompactRatioTooltip: Blocking compaction runs when context reaches this fraction of the max context length.
agentConfig.contextCompactThresholdTooltip: Auto-calculated from max context length × blocking compaction ratio.
agentConfig.earlyBackgroundCompactionEnabledTooltip: When automatic compaction is enabled and context reaches the target below, create a summary checkpoint in the background without making the current conversation wait. When disabled, compaction waits for the blocking threshold.
agentConfig.earlyCompactionTargetRatioTooltip: Calculated as a fraction of the maximum input length. Reaching this target schedules a summary checkpoint in the background; it cannot exceed the blocking compaction threshold.
agentConfig.earlyCompactionTargetRatioRequired: Early compaction target ratio is required
agentConfig.earlyCompactionTargetThresholdTooltip: Auto-calculated from max context length × early compaction target ratio.
agentConfig.contextCompactReserveRatioTooltip: After compaction, the most recent reserve_ratio × max_input_length tokens of context are kept intact to maintain continuity
agentConfig.contextCompactReserveThresholdTooltip: Auto-calculated from max context length × reserve ratio. This many tokens of recent context are preserved after compaction.
agentConfig.toolResultCompactRecentNTooltip: The N tool results immediately before each batch boundary keep their execution-time output, as do results added since that boundary. Older results are truncated to the byte limit below.
agentConfig.toolResultCompactRecentNRequired: Recent tool result rounds is required
agentConfig.toolResultCompactOldThresholdTooltip: Tool results beyond the Tier 1 range are truncated when exceeding this byte limit. Full original content is saved to local files for the agent to re-read via read_file
agentConfig.toolResultCompactRecentThresholdTooltip: When a tool result exceeds this model-visible token limit, it is truncated. Complete output remains available in result storage for inspection.
agentConfig.toolResultCompactRetentionDaysTooltip: How many days complete tool output archives are kept before automatic cleanup.
agentConfig.toolResultCompactRetentionDaysRequired: Original file retention days is required
agentConfig.toolResultCompactOldMaxBytesTooltip: When model context is built, every tool result beyond the recent window is truncated again to this byte limit.
agentConfig.toolResultProjectionTruncationEnabledToo: Advance the truncation boundary in batches, keep its recent window, and truncate every older tool result to the byte limit below. Aging alone does not change history between batches. Full archives remain available through recall_tool_result.
agentConfig.toolResultProjectionTruncationBatchSizeT: Advance the boundary after every N completed tool results in the effective history, applying it before the next model call. 1 preserves rolling truncation; 10 uses boundaries at results 10, 20, 30, and so on. Larger intervals keep the history prefix more stable but retain more content between batches. The context limit is unchanged.
agentConfig.toolResultProjectionTruncationBatchSizeR: Batch interval must be an integer of at least 1
agentConfig.historyReplacementEnabledTooltip: When a completed thinking, tool-call, and tool-result block reaches about 16K tokens, use the active Chat model in the background to create a concise digest. Later model context substitutes the digest for that process block, while the Conversation UI and raw transcript remain unchanged and recoverable through conversation_read_span. Disabled by default.
agentConfig.activeWorkPlanInjectionEnabledTooltip: Periodically append the current Chat's latest update_plan snapshot near the end of model context. Disabled by default.
agentConfig.activeWorkPlanInjectionIntervalTooltip: Reinject the active plan after this share of the context window has been added since update_plan or the previous injection.
agentConfig.compactEnhancedPromptTooltip: Use a richer summarization prompt when compacting; higher quality at a slightly higher token cost.
agentConfig.languageTooltip: Language for agent persona files (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, etc.). Changing this will re-copy MD files in the selected language.
agentConfig.languageConfirmContent:
Changing the language will overwrite the following files with the new language version:

  SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, PROFILE.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, HEARTBEAT.md

If you have customized any of these files, please back them up first. Your other files will not be affected.
agentConfig.resetDescription: The global running configuration on this device will be restored to the application's initial values. Existing Chat configurations will not be changed.
agentConfig.timezoneTooltip: Used for scheduled tasks, time display, and agent context. Defaults to your system timezone.
agentConfig.historyMaxLengthTooltip: Maximum chat history length retained for model context
agentConfig.historyMaxLengthMin: Max history length must be at least 1000
agentConfig.contextCompactEnabledTooltip: Automatically compact the context to prevent context window overflow
agentConfig.tokenCountModelTooltip: Model name used for precise token counting; set to "default" to use built-in estimation
agentConfig.tokenCountUseMirrorTooltip: Use a HuggingFace mirror site when downloading tokenizers
agentConfig.tokenCountEstimateDivisorTooltip: Divisor for byte-based token estimation (tokens ≈ byte_length / divisor). Recommended value: 3.75 ~ 4.
agentConfig.tokenCountEstimateDivisorMin: Estimate divisor must be between 2 and 5
agentConfig.compactWithThinkingBlockTooltip: On: thinking blocks are included in the input sent to the LLM for summarization — better summary quality but more tokens consumed. Off: thinking blocks are stripped before the compaction call — saves tokens but the summary loses reasoning context
agentConfig.stripThinkingDuringCompactionTooltip: Strip thinking blocks only from the input sent to the summarizer. Stored conversation messages and normal model projections are unchanged.
agentConfig.thinkingTurnsToKeepTooltip: When creating a summary checkpoint, include thinking from the most recent N assistant turns. Older thinking is removed only from summarizer input; raw conversation and ordinary model context are unchanged. 0 = remove all, -1 = keep all.
agentConfig.minKeepMessagesTooltip: Minimum number of messages to retain after compaction. Applies to blocking and reactive compaction.
agentConfig.minKeepMessagesRequired: Min messages to keep is required
agentConfig.snipEnabledTooltip: Fold old tool interactions into single-line summaries with file paths so the agent can re-read on demand
agentConfig.toolResultCompactEnabledTooltip: When enabled, full raw output is archived when each tool finishes, and only oversized single results are truncated for model-visible content. Old tool results are no longer round-based compressed on later model calls, preserving prompt-cache stability.
agentConfig.memorySummaryEnabledTooltip: Automatically generate and save memory summaries during context compaction
agentConfig.dreamCronTooltip: Cron expression for periodically optimizing long-term memories through dream state (leave empty to disable)
agentConfig.embeddingApiKeyTooltip: API key for the embedding provider; leave blank if no authentication is required
agentConfig.embeddingBaseUrlTooltip: Base URL of the embedding API. Embedding is enabled when both this and Model Name are filled in.
agentConfig.embeddingModelNameTooltip: Embedding model name. Embedding is enabled when both this and Base URL are filled in.
agentConfig.embeddingEnableCacheTooltip: Cache embedding results to reduce repeated computation
agentConfig.embeddingMaxCacheSizeTooltip: Maximum number of entries in the embedding cache
agentConfig.embeddingUseDimensionsTooltip: Use custom embedding dimensions (only supported by some models)
agentConfig.embeddingDimensionsTooltip: Number of embedding dimensions; takes effect when custom dimensions are enabled
agentConfig.embeddingMaxInputLengthTooltip: Maximum input length (tokens) for a single embedding request
agentConfig.embeddingMaxBatchSizeTooltip: Maximum number of items in a single batch embedding request
agentConfig.embeddingRestartWarning: Embedding model config does not support hot reload. Save and restart the service for changes to take effect.
agentConfig.maxContextLengthTooltip: Maximum token count for the model context window, determining how much history fits in each request
agentConfig.maxContextLengthMin: Max context length must be at least 1000
agentConfig.embeddingActivationNote: Embedding is enabled only when both base_url and model_name are set
agentConfig.embeddingEnableHint: Fill in both Base URL and Model Name to enable the embedding feature. API Key is optional.
agentConfig.toolResultCompactRecentGtOld: Recent messages threshold must be greater than or equal to the older messages threshold

rules.excludePatternsTooltip: One regex per line. If any matches, the rule is skipped for that value.

descriptions.TOOL_CMD_DANGEROUS_RM: Detects 'rm' command that may cause data loss
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_DANGEROUS_MV: Detects 'mv' command that may move or overwrite files unexpectedly
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_FS_DESTRUCTION: Detects low-level disk formatting or wiping commands
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_DOS_FORK_BOMB: Detects classic Bash fork bombs and mass process termination
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_PIPE_TO_SHELL: Detects 'curl | bash' patterns used to download and immediately execute remote payloads
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_REVERSE_SHELL: Detects attempts to establish reverse shells or unauthorized network tunnels
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_SYSTEM_TAMPERING: Detects access to cron jobs, SSH keys, or sudo permissions (including reads and modifications)
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_UNSAFE_PERMISSIONS: Detects global permission downgrades (chmod 777) or setting immutable flags
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_OBFUSCATED_EXEC: Detects execution of base64 encoded strings passed directly to a shell interpreter
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_SYSTEM_REBOOT: Detects system reboot or shutdown commands that will terminate the host system
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_SERVICE_RESTART: Detects service management commands that can disrupt system services
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_PROCESS_KILL: Detects process termination commands that may kill critical processes
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION: Detects privilege escalation attempts using sudo, su, doas, pkexec, or runas
descriptions.SHELL_EVASION_COMMAND_SUBSTITUTION: Detects shell evasion via command substitution ($(), ``, <(), >())
descriptions.SHELL_EVASION_OBFUSCATED_FLAGS: Detects obfuscated flags via ANSI-C quoting ($'...' / $"...")
descriptions.SHELL_EVASION_BACKSLASH_WHITESPACE: Detects backslash + whitespace outside quotes used for evasion
descriptions.SHELL_EVASION_NEWLINE: Detects embedded \r or \n splitting hidden commands
descriptions.SHELL_EVASION_COMMENT_QUOTE_DESYNC: Detects # comment with quote chars for shell evasion
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_CONTROL_CHARS: Detects non-printable control characters in commands that may bypass security checks
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_IFS_INJECTION: Detects use of $IFS variable to bypass security validation
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_JQ_FILE_FLAGS: Detects jq with dangerous flags that can read arbitrary files or load external code
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_JQ_SYSTEM: Detects jq using system() to execute arbitrary shell commands
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_UNICODE_WHITESPACE: Detects Unicode whitespace characters in commands that may cause parsing inconsistencies
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_ZSH_DANGEROUS: Detects zsh module built-in commands that bypass regular command monitoring for raw file/network/exec capabilities
descriptions.TOOL_CMD_PROC_ENVIRON: Detects access to /proc/*/environ which may leak sensitive environment variables

rules.matcherRequired: At least one matcher must be specified

structuralExplain.PipeToShell: Network downloader (curl/wget/fetch) output piped directly to shell execution, e.g. curl http://x | bash
structuralExplain.CommandSubstitution: Command substitution $(...), backticks, or process substitution <()/>() for inline execution, e.g. echo $(whoami)
structuralExplain.SensitiveRedirect: Redirect writing to sensitive files/block devices (/etc/passwd, /dev/sda, etc.), e.g. echo x > /etc/passwd
structuralExplain.ForkBomb: Classic fork bomb — self-referencing function piped recursively and backgrounded to exhaust processes, e.g. :(){ :|:& };:
structuralExplain.Base64ToShell: Base64 decode (-d) output piped to shell execution, e.g. ... | base64 -d | bash

lexicalExplain.ControlChars: Contains non-printable control characters (0x00-0x1F, 0x7F) to bypass text filtering
lexicalExplain.UnicodeWhitespace: Contains Unicode whitespace (non-breaking space U+00A0, fullwidth space U+3000, etc.) disguised as regular spaces
lexicalExplain.IfsReference: References $IFS or ${...IFS}, using the separator variable to hide spaces and bypass filtering, e.g. cat$IFS/etc/passwd
lexicalExplain.AnsiCQuoting: Uses $'...' (ANSI-C quoting) or $"..." to obfuscate arguments
lexicalExplain.BackslashWhitespace: Uses backslash outside quotes to escape spaces and alter parsing boundaries
lexicalExplain.BackslashOperator: Uses backslash outside quotes to escape shell operators (semicolons/pipes/ampersands/redirects) to hide structure
lexicalExplain.EmbeddedNewline: Contains carriage return CR or newline to hide a second command
lexicalExplain.CommentQuoteDesync: Hash comment contains quote characters to disrupt quote state tracking
lexicalExplain.QuotedNewline: Newline inside quotes followed by hash comment line to bypass per-line permission checks
